events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, influential rapper Tupac Shakur passed away, six days after being shot in a drive-by incident in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: 27 years since we lost a hip-hop icon. Tupac Shakur's music and message continue to resonate. What's your go-to track?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix remembered
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix died on this day in 1970 in London, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar Hero Tribute
angles.copy: 56 years since we lost the incomparable Jimi Hendrix. His groundbreaking guitar work changed music forever. What's your favourite Hendrix moment?

events.title: Abbey Road turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic 'Abbey Road' album was released on this day in the UK in 1969, featuring classic tracks like 'Come Together' and 'Something'.

angles.name: Iconic Album Anniversary
angles.copy: It's 57 years since The Beatles dropped 'Abbey Road'. That album cover, those tracks… pure genius. What's your standout song?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde, known for hits like 'Brass in Pocket', celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! A true rock icon with a voice that still commands attention. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54! Happy Birthday to Liam Gallagher – a voice and a swagger that defined a generation. What's your favourite Liam moment, Oasis or solo?

events.title: Imagine album turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal solo album 'Imagine', featuring his signature peace anthem, was released on this day in the US in 1971.

angles.name: Peace Anthem Anniversary
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon gave us the 'Imagine' album. A timeless message of peace that still resonates today. What does 'Imagine' mean to you?

events.title: iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple first introduced the revolutionary iPod, putting '1,000 songs in your pocket', on this day in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Can you believe it's been 25 years since the first iPod? It changed how we listened to music forever. What was your first iPod, and what was on it?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From Connery to Craig, who's your ultimate 007 and what's the best Bond theme tune? Let us know!

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles songwriter and peace activist John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy legend and Monty Python star John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Royalty Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the utterly brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us so many laughs. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The White Album turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles delivered 'The White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece of diverse sounds. What's your hidden gem from the tracklist?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Queen's iconic frontman Freddie Mercury passed away on this day in 1991 due to complications from AIDS.

angles.name: Freddie's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the one and only Freddie Mercury. His voice, his stage presence, his legacy – truly irreplaceable. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: Rubber Soul turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' influential album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in the UK in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: 61 years of 'Rubber Soul'! The Beatles' album that marked a significant shift in their sound. What's your favourite track from this classic?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, the world mourned the loss of John Lennon, who was tragically shot and killed in New York City.

angles.name: Lennon's Tragic Loss
angles.copy: 46 years ago today, we lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to echo globally. What's the song that reminds you most of him?
